page.overview:
Who is Peter?

Cammy faces Peter in A Shadow Falls to prevent a weakened Decapre from being arrested by the police. He is the weakest opponent in the story mode. His only battle is with Cammy.

Although Peter does not appear in Street Fighter 6, according to a post from game director Takayuki Nakayama, Peter retired from police work after the events of A Shadow Falls and now enjoys spending his time playing beach volleyball, whilst the eldest of his three sons has become a police officer.
